mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to stronger economic growth boosting corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite sustained GDPC1 growth, or if GDP growth reverses before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as investors anticipate higher inflation and tighter monetary policy.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not negative when FEDFUNDS remains above 4.5% or if other factors dominate.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal conflicting policy signals, leading to negative returns over 20 days as market uncertainty rises.
failure_condition: 20-day returns positive despite the interaction, or if the proxies don't move together.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 2.5 triggers negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as high inflation expectations prompt rate hikes, reducing equity valuations.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not negative when CPIAUCSL stays above 2.5 or if other inflation factors offset.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production (INDPRO) alongside low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) indicate robust supply and expansionary policy, driving positive returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not positive when the interaction doesn't occur or if other factors dominate.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4%) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days as strong labor market signals economic health.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not positive despite UNRATE staying below 4% or if other labor factors offset.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, S&P 500 forward returns turn negative over 60 days as peak growth nears and investor positioning shifts.
failure_condition: 60-day returns positive in late-cycle regime or if GDPC1 doesn't peak appropriately.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST crossing above 900 (from snapshot value) triggers positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days as rising demand signals sector strength.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not positive when HOUST crosses but other factors negate.
